name: Knight
blurb: Sword gets +2 damage every hit, gains armor when hurt, awakens a MEGA sword.

sfx.ultimate: heavy metallic sword unsheathe with power-up whoosh

art.floor: grey castle courtyard flagstones with mossy cracks between the stones
art.body: a brave knight: the perfectly round ball body is a polished light-grey steel great helm, a dark horizontal visor slit with two glowing eyes inside, small rivets, a tall red feather plume on top
weapons: a steel longsword with a straight double-edged blade, gold crossguard, brown leather grip and a round gold pommel
art.ultimate_icon: a giant glowing steel sword pointing up with light rays
art.ult_circle: a shining steel-blue knightly crest sigil with crossed swords and a shield emblem
art.ult_aura: a tall pillar of brilliant white-blue holy steel light with sword-shaped light rays
art.hit_fx: a sharp white and pale blue sword slash arc with metal sparks
